info.name: Verify a patient and request CCDS data by category

items.docs: Confirms that an ExternalReferencePatientId exists (satisfying 45 CFR 170.315(g)(7) Patient Selection) and returns the requested CCDS categories (satisfying (g)(8) Data Category Request). An optional FromDate / ToDate window filters the returned clinical data. Requires a valid Token and Signature obtained from AuthenticateUser.

info.name: Request all available CCDS data for a patient

items.docs: Returns the complete Common Clinical Data Set for a patient (satisfying 45 CFR 170.315(g)(9) All Data Request). An optional FromDate / ToDate window filters the returned clinical data. Requires a valid Token and Signature obtained from AuthenticateUser.
